title: Forming a band for the Chateau Country Club
summary: From a sickbed he phones Milwaukee musicians, rehearses in the ballroom and plays three weeks that stretch to eight months.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Oh, yeah, but can you imagine that - I couldn't get out of bed; I was really sicker than hell-- and I had never been sick before that. So, in the meantime, there was a guy that had a place called "The Chateau Country Club" in Milwaukee and he called me and said --- listen, how would you like to put a band in my club -- and, so, Carl -- I didn't know any Milwaukee musicians hardly -- at that time -- only the ones that we got together for the ballroom job--- and I got some of those guys together and formed a band and we went out to the Chateau Country Club -- we did this all on the telephone and he'd give me the ballroom to rehearse in and we went out -- we rehearsed and got the band all straight; we had to play shows as well; I had to get a good first trumpet player and we went out there for three weeks and we stayed eight months on that job and it was very, very enjoyable job. And, then, when I got out of there, of course, there were so many things happening -- you know, I stayed there what--- six years---
No, you were there almost ten years---
